subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost opening handshakes fail closed after 30 seconds, matching the existing sibling transport precedent?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but selecting a hard timeout determines how unusually slow Mattermost servers and proxies behave and therefore needs channel-owner intent.

options.title: Approve 30 seconds
options.body: Land the fixed threshold as the Mattermost reliability policy, using the submitted production-path proof.

options.title: Choose another threshold
options.body: Select a different owner-approved duration and rerun the same stalled-handshake reconnect proof.

recommendation.title: Approve 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the fixed threshold as the Mattermost reliability policy, using the submitted production-path proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the reconnect lifecycle that receives and acts on this timeout failure.
